data.description:
## Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker (observed during 588e reconciliation)

### Expected
`ticket link <a> <b> <rel> --dry-run` previews the operation WITHOUT writing any event (per ticket-cli-reference.md:483/529: '--dry-run ... without writing any event; prints what would happen'). ticket-link.sh honors this: `[DRY RUN] Would create: ... (no event written)`.

### Actual
The canonical dispatcher path (`dso ticket link` / `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket link`, which routes 'link' to ticket-graph.py 'by design') IGNORES --dry-run: it exits 0, prints NOTHING, and WRITES the link. Repro: `ticket link 0734-6880-76be-425e 588e-abec-221f-42c0 relates_to --dry-run` -> 0734 subsequently shows ('relates_to','588e-abec') in deps (verified via ticket show); the only relates_to invocation was the --dry-run. The legacy host shim instead REJECTS --dry-run ('Usage: ticket link <id1> <id2> <relation>').

### Impact
A 'dry-run' that mutates is a data-safety hazard; any verification protocol that previews links via the canonical CLI (e.g. a reconciliation dry-run gate) will silently write. Workaround: use `ticket-link.sh link ... --dry-run` directly (inefficient, non-obvious).

### Environment
* code_version: b68f1cfcdb09a2d7a44007262af3d83e6385e845
* dispatcher: plugins/dso/scripts/ticket (link -> ticket-graph.py); ticket-link.sh has the real dry-run.
data.title: ticket link: --dry-run -> mutates the graph (writes the link) and emits no preview via the dispatcher
